newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop offers more luxury HK flats.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop offers more luxury HK flats.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday it would put another 78 units, on top of 36 flats already on offer in its luxury King's Park Villa residential development, due to strong response.
The company spokeswoman said the additional units would be offered at a four percent higher price at HK$8,985 per square foot (sq ft).
The spokeswoman said 560 potential buyers have registered to buy the first batch of 36 units on Monday, offered at an average of HK$8,640 per sq ft.
Registration for buyers closes on Wednesday.
The development in Ho Man Tin, Kowloon, has a total floor area of 474,123 sq ft and will be completed in March 1997.

It comprises six 21-storey residential blocks providing 342 units with areas ranging from 1,109 to 1,508 sq ft, 18 duplexes with areas ranging from 2,086 to 2,465 sq ft, and a four-level car park with 360 parking spaces.
